# Nova Intelligence Raises $40M to Build the Frontier AI Platform for SAP  
Nova Intelligence has raised $40M in funding across seed and Series A to build the frontier AI platform for SAP. The Series A was led by Chemistry, with participation from Accel, Conviction, and SAP.io, SAP's venture arm. The seed was led by Accel, with participation from Conviction and SAP.io.  
Nova Intelligence announces $40M in funding across seed and Series A to build the frontier AI platform for SAP — the system of record for the world's largest enterprises. The Series A was led by Chemistry, with participation from Accel, Conviction, and SAP.iO. The seed was led by Accel, with participation from Conviction and SAP.iO.  
SAP is the heart of the enterprise. 92% of the Global 2000 rely on SAP to run their most important business processes — finance, supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, sales, and more. These environments are deeply customized to fit each company's unique business needs, which is why every dollar spent on SAP software drives roughly seven dollars in services. With a mandatory migration to SAP's next-generation platform by 2030 — a project costing some companies over a billion dollars — the pressure on SAP teams has never been greater. Nova helps SAP teams work faster, spend less, and reduce risk through this migration and beyond, across the full SAP lifecycle from design and development to testing and day-to-day operations.  
**Purpose-Built for SAP Teams**
**Strong Results for Customers**  
Nova is battle-tested in production across some of the most complex SAP environments in the world — including companies that have run SAP for decades at massive scale.  
Festo, a German automation leader and one of the first 30 SAP customers in history, runs SAP across more than 15,000 users in 61 countries. Teams using Nova report more than 5x productivity gains across their daily work. Documentation that once took three months now takes a single day, and projects that were previously out of scope are now viable.  
> "How we answer every one of the big three questions about our SAP program — how long will it take, how much will it cost, and how big is the risk — has improved significantly since adding Nova to our teams. Our team estimates they are more than 5x more productive on average across all tasks. That level of capacity increase completely changes the game for our organization." Jörn Weigle, CIO of Festo.  
KION Group, a global industrial leader with €11B+ in revenue, has seen similarly strong results, including a 400% improvement in production application performance and faster development cycles across its SAP teams.  
> "Nova Intelligence addresses the two requirements that matter most to us: operating truly Clean-Core-compliant systems and achieving the development performance our SAP landscape demands. The results have been outstanding," Carsten Engelbrecht, CIO of KION Group.

results.name: Nova Intelligence Raises $31.5M Series A | The SaaS News
results.content:
Nova Intelligence, a San Francisco, CA-based agentic AI platform designed to modernize and automate SAP enterprise systems, has raised $31.5 million in Series A funding.  
**Investors**  
The round was led by Chemistry, with participation from existing investors Accel, Conviction, and SAP.io, bringingNova Intelligence's total funding to over $40 million.  
Chemistry Ventures is a venture capital firm founded in 2024 and based in San Francisco. It focuses on investing in early-stage technology startups, particularly in areas such as fintech, software infrastructure, and emerging technologies like AI. The firm typically leads Seed and Series A funding rounds.  
**Nova Intelligence Use of Funds**  
The company will use the funding to accelerate research and development and expand its go-to-market team targeting large enterprise customers.  
**About Nova Intelligence**
**About Nova Intelligence**  
Led by CEO Emma Qian, Nova Intelligence is an enterprise AI company that has built an agentic AI platform specifically for SAP enterprises. The platform helps organizations accelerate development, modernization, testing, documentation, and operational workflows across complex SAP environments. Nova Intelligence focuses on enabling safer and faster SAP transformation projects, including large-scale S/4HANA migrations, through customizable AI agents designed for enterprise SAP teams. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, Nova works with global enterprises across the manufacturing, logistics, and industrial sectors.  
**Funding Details**  
Company: Nova Intelligence  
Raised: $31.5M  
Round: Series A  
Funding Date: May 2026  
Lead Investor: Chemistry  
Additional Investors: Accel, Conviction, SAP.io

results.name: Nova Intelligence Raises $40M Series A for SAP AI - TAMradar Funding Rounds Signals
results.content:
Nova Intelligence raised $40M Series A led by Chemistry for agentic AI platform boosting SAP team productivity 5x. Targets $89B S/4HANA migration as Clean Core deadline nears, backed by Accel, Conviction, SAP.iO.
Nova's raise times with the accelerating S/4HANA migration wave valued at $89B, as SAP ECC support ends in 2027 with extensions to 2030 at premium fees. Competitors including Conduct, focused on SAP customization management, and Dodge AI, specializing in ERP support automation, target overlapping pains in complex SAP environments. Nova differentiates through end-to-end agentic AI covering understanding, modernization, and building. This positions it amid S/4HANA applications growing from $51.12B in 2026 to $333.92B by 2035.
Nova's platform ingests SAP systems for instant natural language queries on code, configs, and processes. It performs fit-to-standard analysis to slash custom code and generates Clean Core-compliant ABAP and BTP apps via AI agents.
Nova partners with Kyndryl for modernizations and joined Chevron Technology Ventures Catalyst. With funding, the team of 20 plans GTM expansion and platform scaling.
Chemistry, a new VC with partners from Bessemer, a16z, and Index, led the $31.5M Series A portion of the $40M total. Their portfolio in agentic AI like Decagon and Serval signals conviction in Nova's SAP specialization.
